metadata_audit.scope: CTX-HPF MOp and VISp; RNA-seq cell counts are sampling counts, not tissue composition
metadata_audit.genotype_policy: Retain raw annotation; do not infer WT or C57BL/6J from missing values
metadata_audit.animal_inference: withheld; donor/pool independence and region/batch confounding require documented review

animal_statistics: not performed; independent biological-unit mapping and design review required
comparison_interpretation: descriptive matched annotation labels; matching chemistry/genotype/age/sex/FACS is unverified where unknown
reported_difference: MOp minus VISp in the supplied normalized expression scale; not log2FC unless separately modeled
